title: The Case Study of Vanitas — What Science Actually Says #Shorts
description:
Strip The Case Study of Vanitas of its poetry and the mechanism underneath is stranger. The Case Study of Vanitas (Japanese: ヴァニタスの手記（カルテ）, Hepburn: Vanitasu no Karute) is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Jun Mochizuki. It has been serialized in Square Enix's shōnen manga magazine Monthly Gangan Joker since December 2015.

Nihilism is not the conclusion of The Case Study of Vanitas — it is the floor you stand on while examining it. Plus Media Networks Asia has licensed the series in Southeast Asia and released it on Aniplus Asia and IQIYI. Critics enjoyed the handling of Vanitas and the setting, praising the mix of action, humor and adventure, as well as Vanitas's relationship with Noé.
